subject: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test onboarding — scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — request for walkthrough & times

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our InfoSec team would like to schedule a combined walkthrough to cover: our DPA review, your SOC 2 controls overview, and the planned pen-test scope. We'd prefer a single 60-minute session where we can cover high-level controls and agree the pen-test boundary.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-10, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-11-11, 14:00–15:00

I've attached our preliminary questionnaire (Acme-security-questions.xlsx) — please have any relevant folks from your security or compliance team review before the call. Our InfoSec manager, David Chen (cc'd on follow-ups), will join.

Can you confirm availability and an agenda?

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director, Information Security
Acme Corporation

Attachment: Acme-security-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — request for walkthrough & times

Elena —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. We can do a 60-minute slot; either Tue 11/10 10:00–11:00 PST or Wed 11/11 14:00–15:00 PST works for our team, but I want to make sure Marissa (security/compliance) and Vivek (solutions) are available for the controls + operational questions. They are cc'd.

Proposed agenda (high-level):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) Controls overview (SOC 2 sysdesc + DPA items) (20m)
3) Pen-test scope & required evidence (20m)
4) Next steps / mutual action items (15m)

Marissa — can you confirm which of the two windows you prefer? Also, two asks for the call prep:
- Can Acme indicate if the pen test will include SC network-level testing vs. application-level only? (David, quick note here would help.)
- Please upload any sample logs or retention policies you want to review to the shared drive — here's where we'll collect: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-onboarding/ACME-5421

If those windows don't work we'll propose alternatives.

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Note: I can send a calendar invite once we lock time.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — request for walkthrough & times

Hi Elena / Rohan —

Thanks for the questionnaire — I reviewed the spreadsheet quickly and added a few inline notes (will upload a redlined copy to the Drive). Either slot works for me but I prefer Wed 11/11 14:00–15:00 PST to give our pen-test lead time to pull the test plan.

Prep checklist from our side:
- I'll bring the SOC 2 controls map and a short PDF overview of our control families (attached: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf).
- Please confirm the expected pen-test focus (network vs app) and whether you require us to provide IP allowlist ranges for an external tester.
- If you have contract redlines already, please share them ahead of the call so we can surface legal questions.

Draft agenda (60m):
- 0–05m: Introductions & goals
- 05–25m: SOC 2 controls overview + DPA touchpoints
- 25–45m: Pen-test scope and logistics (who, when, scope boundaries)
- 45–60m: Action items & shared next steps (MVP test window, evidence handoff)

I will attach the redlined questionnaire to the Drive and add a mutual action plan template (redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx) we like to use for these engagements.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test — request for walkthrough & times

Hi Marissa —

Thanks, Wed 11/11 14:00 PST works for us (I can confirm David will be on the call). A couple of clarifications from our side:
- The pen-test will be a combined external app + auth flow exercise (no low-level network scanning unless otherwise agreed).
- We'll need to agree on a mutually acceptable testing window (we typically run tests during off-peak hours) and a waiver/statement of work that lists IPs and allowed tester behavior.

I've uploaded a brief network topology and a list of in-scope hosts to the Drive and updated the questionnaire. See attachment note: Acme-security-questions.xlsx (v2).

Would you prefer to run the onboarding call over Zoom or Google Meet? Also — we need to move the call by 30 minutes later because a cross-team sync at our end ran over. Could we start at 14:30–15:30 PST instead?

Thanks,
Elena

Attachment: Acme-security-questions.xlsx (v2, 52KB)

Items I'll include in the invite body:
- Google Meet link + dial-in
- Agenda (as discussed)
- Pre-read links: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf, mutual action plan template
- Calendar attachment: calendar-invite.ics

Marissa / Vivek will bring technical and product context. David — nice to meet you in advance, we'll give you the pen-test checklist and ask about required point-of-contact for the testing window.

I'll post the invite in ~10 minutes (watch for hubspot deal update).

—Rohan
